returned_title: Political Action: An Eight Nation Study, 1973-1976
justification: Conducted between 1973 and 1976 across eight nations including West Germany, this dataset contains cross-sectional survey data and parent-child dyad data covering West German voting behavior, party preferences, political attitudes, satisfaction with democracy, subjective social class identity, family political socialization, economic expectations, and issue priorities regarding the environment, inflation, and protest.

Initiated in 1977 by Forschungsgruppe Wahlen and archived at GESIS (ZA2391), this monthly time-series survey captures West German political attitudes, voting intentions, party preferences, evaluations of chancellor candidates and top politicians, economic expectations, and priorities on key political issues including inflation, environmental policy, and peace negotiations.

Archived at GESIS (ZA0626), this 1970 survey measures West German public opinion, political attitudes toward democratic governance, party and political orientations, subjective social standing, economic expectations, and priorities on international affairs, defense, and peace policy at the beginning of the 1970s.

This dataset, created by Gertrud Beck at the University of Gießen (Hesse) in 1969, focuses on the role of authority in political socialization during preschool age. It features survey data from both preschool children and their parents, covering family authority structures, parents' child-rearing practices, attitudes toward authority and punishment, educational goals, perceptions of public authority figures, and demographic household characteristics.

Compiled by Wolfram Schulz and Harold Hurwitz (FU Berlin) and archived at GESIS (ZA8081), this dataset contains election results and census indicators for Berlin districts from 1930 to 1963. It includes detailed 1950s data on political preferences, voting behavior, population demographics, age distribution, employment, and housing conditions in postwar West Berlin.

Conducted by Gabriel Almond and Sidney Verba and distributed by ICPSR, this foundational survey includes respondents from West Germany (including West Berlin) in the late 1950s. It captures post-war political behavior and attitudes, opinions on government institutions, economic recovery, rearmament, civic engagement, and comparisons between political systems.

This biennial survey contains representative data on the German population's political attitudes, trust in democratic institutions, political participation, media consumption, and general opinions on Germany's political situation in 2018.

returned_title: German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) 2017 - Post-election Cross-Section
justification: Part of the GLES project for the 2017 German federal election, this dataset covers opinions on political parties, candidates, trust in democracy, media consumption during the campaign, and voter behavior.

A cumulated dataset of monthly survey waves conducted in 2015 that measures public opinion in Germany regarding government performance, trust in politics, evaluations of parties and top politicians, and political attitudes.

returned_title: German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) 2017 - Short-term Campaign Panel
justification: A multi-wave panel survey collected during the 2017 election campaign in Germany, capturing dynamic changes in political media usage, party/politician ratings, political participation, and views on the German political system.

Conducted by the GDR's Staatliches Komitee für Fernsehen (Sociological Research Department) in 1987, this dataset measures audience participation, TV viewing behavior, evaluation of TV moderators, program realism/plot ratings, overall impressions, and respondent demographics.

Part of the GESIS dataset collection 'Watching Television in the GDR (1982-1990)', this weekly survey collects GDR television audience participation numbers, program ratings, evaluation of specific show components, and detailed viewer demographics.

This 1986 dataset records GDR viewer participation and evaluation of specific programs and series (e.g., Der schwarze Kanal, Asse im Spiel), assessing entertainment value, format realism, viewer satisfaction, and demographic background.

returned_title: Second European Survey of Enterprises on New and Emerging Risks, 2014 (ESENER-2)
justification: Conducted in 2014 across 36 European countries (including EU Member States and non-EU countries in the prompt), this establishment-level survey captures responses from safety and health management representatives across public and private workplaces on occupational safety and health management, psychosocial risk factors (work-related stress, violence, harassment), musculoskeletal risks, risk assessment practices, worker participation, and organizational drivers and barriers.

returned_title: Third European Survey of Enterprises on New and Emerging Risks, 2019 (ESENER-3)
justification: Conducted in 2019 across 33 European countries, this dataset provides establishment-level survey data from public and private workplaces on health and safety management practices, psychosocial risk management (stress, bullying, harassment), physical risk factors including musculoskeletal disorders, risk assessment implementation, employee participation, and organizational drivers and barriers.

returned_title: European Survey of Enterprises on New and Emerging Risks, 2009 (ESENER-1)
justification: Conducted at the threshold of the 2010s across 31 European countries, this establishment-level dataset covers occupational safety and health management, psychosocial risks, risk assessment procedures, worker representation, and drivers and barriers in European workplaces.

Conducted by the Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung (ZIJ) in Leipzig, this East German (GDR) survey collected data entering the 1980s regarding partnership quality, sexuality, contraception, family planning, partner relations, and gender role expectations.

Administered by ZIJ Leipzig and the Research Center for Partner and Sexual Research, this GDR dataset focuses on East German university students, capturing detailed data on sexuality, contraception, partnership quality, domestic arrangements, reproductive health, and gender roles.

A longitudinal study conducted in the GDR between 1982 and 1988 by ZIJ Leipzig tracking living and study conditions, physical and psychological health, drug use, contraception, pregnancy, partnership relations, family life, housing, and work-family balance.

An interval panel survey from the GDR during the 1980s that tracks young people's attitudes and behaviors regarding sexuality, partner relationships, gender role orientations, health, and family planning.

returned_title: Sexualverhalten von Männern und Frauen in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland 1988
justification: This representative GESIS dataset from 1988 covers sexual behavior, attitudes toward sexuality and AIDS, condom use, partner relationships, and sexual practices among men and women in West Germany during the 1980s.

returned_title: Einstellungen zu Sexualität und AIDS (Attitude to Sexuality and AIDS)
justification: Archived at the GESIS Data Archive, this survey investigates public attitudes toward sexuality, HIV/AIDS knowledge, risk perception, prevention behaviors, and partner relationships in Germany during the late 1980s.

returned_title: AIDS im öffentlichen Bewußtsein der Bundesrepublik 1991-1992 (Kumulierter Datensatz)
justification: Part of the long-running annual survey series commissioned by the Federal Centre for Health Education (BZgA) starting in 1987, this dataset measures knowledge, attitudes, condom use, risk behaviors, and the social impact of HIV/AIDS in Germany.

Conducted around 1990 by the AG Sexualität (Forschungsstelle Partner- und Sexualforschung), this survey collects data on partnership development, sexual behavior, first sexual contacts, contraceptive choices, sexual practices, and attitudes regarding AIDS.

This dataset provides microdata transcribed from 18th-century probate inventory samples (1773–1775) across 21 colonial counties, including Massachusetts and South Carolina. It contains specific information on firearm ownership (counts, weapon types, and monetary values), slaveholding, decedent demographics, county/locality, and overall estate wealth.

Created by Alice Hanson Jones, this landmark probate inventory collection includes microdata on 919 decedents from 1774 across colonial counties in New England, Middle, and Southern regions (including Massachusetts and South Carolina). It records itemized personal property including firearms, total estate value, slaveholding, gender, and locality.

returned_title: Readers Digest Survey of Europe Today, 1969
justification: This 1969 cross-national survey dataset covers 16 Western European nations including Finland. It contains data on household consumption, durable goods, car ownership, drinking habits, media use, travel, advertising attitudes, social tolerance, public opinions on the EEC, as well as demographic and housing characteristics.

This dataset from GESIS (collected in 1975 by the Deutsches Jugendinstitut München) surveys graduates of the University and Technical College of Munich who completed their studies in 1972. It contains individual-level data directly covering educational pathways, family social background, study interruptions between secondary school and higher education, career choices, job characteristics, workplace attitudes, income, and life satisfaction in 1970s Bavaria.

Conducted by the Institut für praxisorientierte Sozialforschung (IPOS) in May 1999 specifically for the 50th anniversary of the Federal Republic of Germany, this dataset contains survey data on Germans' evaluations of democracy and the political system, party preference, reunification, social market economy, optimism about Germany's future, and demographic characteristics.

This 1998 wave of the ALLBUS survey provides population-representative data on social conditions, economic evaluations, attitudes toward democratic institutions, party preferences, and demographic indicators in East and West Germany in the late 1990s.

Distributed by GESIS, this dataset collects data on political attitudes, party preferences, candidate evaluations, government performance, and voting behavior in Germany around the 1998 federal election.

returned_title: Zukunft_EmSoz - Zukunftsentwürfe von Jugendlichen an Förderschulen der emotionalen und sozialen Entwicklung
justification: This dataset specifically investigates the future life plans and aspirations of adolescents attending special schools (Förderschulen) for emotional and social development in Germany. It collects comprehensive data on youth expectations regarding employment, family life, housing, finances, leisure activities, and political/civic participation, along with relevant demographic information such as school type and migration background.

This GESIS survey dataset covers Duisburg (NRW) residents in spring 2000, measuring housing conditions and satisfaction, municipal administration and local politics, local economic climate, public services, leisure activities, museum use, transport, and demographic characteristics.

This survey dataset collects representative data from Duisburg residents in autumn 2000 on housing satisfaction, local economic perceptions, municipal government and politics, public services, living environment, and demographics.

This dataset provides survey data from autumn 2001 on Duisburg residents' housing conditions and satisfaction, local economic perceptions, local politics and municipal administration, public services, and sociodemographic characteristics.

Conducted in September 1993 across the EC12 countries (Belgium, Germany, Denmark, France, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, Spain, and Great Britain), this Flash Eurobarometer dataset surveys business managers on their awareness and use of EU institutions supporting small and medium-sized businesses, information sources, knowledge of European business promotion events, foreign support organizations, and firm characteristics.

This dataset from the Flash Eurobarometer series targets business managers across European Union member states, covering business management, industrial organisation, perceptions of EU institutions, and support mechanisms for small and medium-sized enterprises.

This GESIS dataset (ZA3469) provides survey data collected in Duisburg, North Rhine-Westphalia in Autumn 2000. It covers housing satisfaction, living conditions, environmental problems, interethnic relations, discrimination, German language skills, media use, and contacts with municipal administration among local residents.

Conducted by the Staatliches Komitee für Fernsehen (Abteilung Soziologische Forschung) in the German Democratic Republic, this weekly survey captures television viewing behavior, program awareness, ratings and evaluations of specific GDR TV programs and presenters, media usage habits, and individual demographic characteristics.

Part of the GDR sociological audience research series from the 1980s stored at GESIS, capturing weekly audience participation, viewing habits, evaluations of television broadcasts, household media equipment, and detailed demographic attributes of respondents in East Germany.

returned_title: Interessen, Wünsche und Erwartungen von Kinobesuchern 1989 [ZA6047]
justification: Conducted by the Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung (ZIJ) in Leipzig in 1989, this survey covers cinema attendance, interest in DEFA films and cinema scheduling, frequency of watching films on GDR television, general leisure and media preferences, and respondent demographic characteristics.

Created by Margaret Peil and archived at the UK Data Service, this survey covers Ajegunle (Lagos) alongside other Nigerian cities. It collects empirical data on women and men regarding household living conditions, migration patterns, housing, occupations, income, business activities of traders and craftswomen, associational/union involvement, and unemployment.

Created by SAFE in collaboration with Goethe University, this dataset provides monthly time series from 1871 to 1914 covering 1,459 firms across six regional German stock exchanges, including stock prices, dividend payments, capital levels, and industry classifications.

returned_title: The long-term rate of return of german stock 1870 to 1959 (GESIS ZA8281)
justification: Compiled by Ulrich Ronge and archived at GESIS, this dataset offers historical capital market time series for Germany from 1870 onwards, including nominal and price-adjusted stock market indices and annual returns covering the German Reich period before WWI.

returned_title: Time series of money in circulation in Germany between 1870 and 1913 (GESIS ZA8230)
justification: Compiled by Richard H. Tilly, this GESIS dataset contains historical time series on money supply, banknote circulation, bank deposits, metallic money, and financial market indicators in the German Empire from 1870 to 1913.

returned_title: Index of Stock Prices for Germany (NBER Macrohistory Database / FRED)
justification: Hosted on FRED from the NBER Macrohistory Database, this dataset provides monthly time series of German stock price indices covering the period from January 1870 through December 1913.

returned_title: Bevölkerung und Recht in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland (Population and Law in the Federal Republic of Germany, 1970)
justification: This 1970 survey dataset (GESIS Study ZA0641) examines public opinions on law, judicial institutions, law enforcement, punishment goals, and attitudes toward capital punishment (Todesstrafe) in West Germany. It contains comprehensive socio-demographic variables matching the query requirement: age, sex, marital status, religion and religiosity, general and vocational education, employment and occupation, household income, household composition/children, city size, and state (Bundesland).

returned_title: Political Attitudes in East and West, March 1990 (Comparative Survey FRG - GDR)
justification: This GESIS comparative survey conducted in March 1990 measures political attitudes, evaluations of politicians and parties, and expected socio-economic changes across both the GDR and FRG during the transition period.

returned_title: Mecklenburg-West Pomerania and Saxony in Advance of the State Parliament Elections 1990
justification: Focuses on former East German territories (GDR) in 1990, capturing survey data on local political attitudes, party preferences, municipal election influences, and evaluations of candidate competence.

Provides harmonized municipality-level panel data on municipal, state, and federal elections across former GDR and FRG regions starting in the 1990s, measuring voter turnout, political representation, and party performance.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme: National Identity I - ISSP 1995
justification: Includes survey data from Germany in the mid-1990s covering work and geographic mobility, housing and living conditions, local community attachment, and citizen attitudes toward government representation.

Conducted in Decatur, Illinois in 1945 by Elihu Katz and Paul F. Lazarsfeld, this classic study investigates interpersonal opinion leaders and social networks. It examines the influence of opinion leaders on consumer choices (marketing), fashion, political attitudes, moviegoing, and mass media usage, and includes a follow-up panel survey of nominated influencers with demographic variables.

Archived at the GESIS Data Archive in Cologne, this survey series provides cross-sectional data from West Germany (including North Rhine-Westphalia and the Cologne region) collected throughout the 1980s, covering leisure activities, shopping and consumer habits, car ownership, commuting/travel behavior, housing tenure, and respondent demographics.

returned_title: Allgemeine Bevölkerungsumfrage der Sozialwissenschaften ALLBUScompact - Kumulation 1980-2010
justification: Curated by GESIS Data Archive in Cologne, this dataset contains cumulative survey modules from 1980 onward covering population demographics, housing conditions, consumer behavior, travel/commuting patterns, and leisure engagement in North Rhine-Westphalia.

returned_title: European Values Study Longitudinal Data File 1981-2008 (EVS 1981-2008)
justification: Distributed by GESIS Data Archive, this dataset includes survey waves starting in 1981 that examine social values, community and urban life, leisure habits, consumer behavior, and demographic profiles across West Germany, including North Rhine-Westphalia.

returned_title: GESIS Panel.pop Special Survey on the Coronavirus SARS-CoV-2 Outbreak in Germany
justification: This dataset provides representative population survey data collected in Germany during the 2020 COVID-19 outbreak. It covers infection risk perceptions, evaluations of government measures, changes in working conditions (including home office), media consumption, and demographic characteristics including age, sex, education, income, and region.

COSMO Germany consists of 69 serial cross-sectional representative population surveys conducted between 2020 and 2023. It contains variables on infection worries, information levels, trust in government and health policies, work/life changes, and comprehensive participant demographics.

returned_title: SOEP-CoV: Socio-Economic Panel COVID-19 Study in Germany
justification: SOEP-CoV is a representative longitudinal survey of private households in Germany during 2020 and 2021. It examines COVID-19 health risks, labor market and home office arrangements, policy perceptions, and rich demographic information including age, sex, education, household income, region, and political preferences.

returned_title: Preparatory Investigation according to the Law to Promote Urban Development (Municipality Data)
justification: This GESIS Data Archive dataset (ZA1157), compiled by the Arbeitsgruppe Stadtforschung at the University of Oldenburg, provides aggregate data on urban renewal areas (Sanierungsgebiete) in West Germany. It covers structural and socioeconomic indicators including building density, company/business structure, housing quality, demographics, employment, household composition, renters, foreign residents, and local planning processes.

Conducted by the Städtebauinstitut Nürnberg in 1968, this GESIS dataset (ZA0488) collects empirical data on urban development areas in West Germany, examining neighborhood infrastructure, building conditions, housing quality, heating/facilities, and household demographics.

This 1969 dataset (ZA0551) from GESIS captures housing and living conditions across urban areas in West Germany, measuring structural building damage, commercial usage, tenant satisfaction, household structure, and local civic participation indicators.

The German Internet Panel (GIP) is a long-term, probability-based online panel study operated by the University of Mannheim in cooperation with GESIS. Running bi-monthly through the 2020s, it collects internet-based survey data from Germany on individual attitudes and preferences relevant to political and economic decision-making, covering employment, social welfare policy, political behaviour, health, migration, and government policy reforms.

The GESIS Panel is an open probability-based mixed-mode (predominantly web-based) longitudinal survey of the general population in Germany running through the 2020s. It regularly measures political attitudes and behaviour, economic decision-making, employment status, social welfare preferences, health conditions, and views on migration and social service availability.

The GLES Panel is a primary web-based longitudinal survey tracking political and societal attitudes, political behaviour, voting choices, government system evaluations, and economic preferences among eligible voters in Germany throughout the 2020s.

returned_title: GESIS Panel Special Survey on the Coronavirus SARS-CoV-2 Outbreak in Germany
justification: Conducted in 2020 using the GESIS Panel online infrastructure, this high-frequency panel dataset collects individual data in Germany regarding specific diseases and medical conditions (COVID-19), health behaviors, trust in government, political attitudes, employment changes, and social welfare support.

This dataset consists of daily representative CATI telephone survey data of eligible voters in Germany collected throughout 1992 by the FORSA polling institute. It covers individual political attitudes, candidate and party preferences, voting behavior in past elections, and economic expectations.

Part of the ongoing FORSA daily omnibus survey series in Germany, this 1995 annual accumulation captures around 500 telephone interviews per day of eligible voters on political preferences, past voting behavior, government competence, and economic development.

returned_title: Research Data Center Elections at GESIS - Forsa-Bus Data Series
justification: The Research Data Center Elections at GESIS archives and provides academic access to the entire Forsa-Bus collection (available from 1991 onwards), which tracks political attitudes, party and chancellor preferences, and voting behavior of eligible voters in Germany on a daily basis.

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 550: EU Challenges and Priorities
justification: Fielded in June and July 2024 across all 27 EU Member States, this Eurobarometer survey provides public opinion data specifically evaluating EU citizens' perceptions of the main challenges facing the EU (such as the war in Ukraine, irregular migration, and climate change) and their top policy priorities for the European Union.

Fielded in April 2024 across the EU-27, Standard Eurobarometer 101 measures European public opinion on international politics, security and defence, satisfaction with EU democracy, and citizen priorities regarding key geopolitical and economic challenges.

Conducted in early 2024 in all 27 EU Member States prior to the European Parliament elections, this dataset captures public opinion on political priorities (such as fighting poverty, public health, and EU defence), political behavior, and citizens' views on the EU's position in global politics.

This dataset (GESIS Study ZA2326) contains survey data collected by Westdeutsche Genossenschafts-Zentralbank (WGZ-Bank) on medium-sized companies in North Rhine-Westphalia and Rhineland-Palatinate for 1991–1992. It covers company business conditions, turnover, costs, sales prices, profit margins, capital endowment, investment motives, self-financing and loan financing, as well as sales and investment expectations in the former East Germany and Eastern Europe.

returned_title: Lagebericht Mittelstand im Sommer 1992 (Situation Report Medium-Sized Companies in Summer 1992)
justification: This dataset (GESIS Study ZA2327) surveyed medium-sized enterprises in the Rhenish-Westphalian region during summer 1992 regarding current business situation, turnover, cost developments, investment plans, financing proportions, and expectations for business in the second half of 1992.

This GESIS dataset contains representative survey data collected across 1998 leading up to the 1998 German federal election, capturing party identification, vote intentions, candidate and party evaluations, issue competence, political attitudes, and demographics.

returned_title: Politische Einstellungen, politische Partizipation und Wählerverhalten im vereinigten Deutschland 1998 (Deutsche Nationale Wahlstudie 1998)
justification: This national election survey dataset (ZA3066) covers German voters around the 1998 federal election, measuring party preferences, voting intentions, government and opposition evaluations, issue competence, social values, and socio-demographic characteristics.

returned_title: German National Election Study - Post-Election Study 1998 German CSES Study
justification: Conducted in connection with the 1998 German federal election (ZA3073), this dataset captures voter choices, candidate and party evaluations, political attitudes, party identification, and demographic data.

returned_title: The Berlin Pulse - German Foreign Policy 2024
justification: This GESIS archive dataset (ZA8996), commissioned by the Körber Foundation and fielded in September 2024, directly measures eligible voters in Germany on foreign policy challenges, security threats, transatlantic relations, China, defense spending, and Germany/EU roles in the Russia-Ukraine and Israel-Hamas conflicts.

returned_title: Pew Research Center Spring 2024 Global Attitudes Survey Data
justification: This dataset from Pew Research Center's Spring 2024 survey includes representative public opinion data from Germany covering international affairs, security threats, NATO, transatlantic relations, views on China, and foreign policy attitudes.

returned_title: Die Praktizierung des Jugendarbeitsschutzes in Hessen aus der Sicht Jugendlicher (ZA1376)
justification: This GESIS dataset (ZA1376) surveyed young workers and apprentices in Hesse between October 1983 and April 1984. It directly addresses training and employment conditions, working hours, overtime, weekend work, conflicts regarding vocational school, vacation entitlements, workplace representation (Jugendvertretung/Betriebsrat), union membership, and compliance with occupational health and safety regulations under the Youth Employment Protection Act (Jugendarbeitsschutzgesetz).

The German Business Panel Covid-19 Survey (2020/2021) provides longitudinal firm-level survey data from executives and key decision-makers across Germany. It captures key outcomes such as revenues and profits, managerial perceptions of economic uncertainty, take-up of government economic support policies, crisis mitigation strategies, and planned investment and employment during 2020–2021.

The Bundesbank Online Panel – Firms (BOP-F) is a longitudinal micro-data panel of German companies launched in June 2020. It covers firm assessments and expectations regarding revenues, profits, economic uncertainty, take-up of subsidized loans/government support, and planned employment and investment during the COVID-19 crisis.

returned_title: histat - Datenkompilation online: Löhne und Gehälter (Indizes) in Deutschland 1913/14 bis 2006
justification: This historical time-series dataset (ZA8614) compiles index data on German wages and salaries, collective bargaining pay indices, and tariff vs. effective earnings covering historical periods from 1913 through 2006.

returned_title: histat - Datenkompilation online: Bruttoverdienste der Arbeiter und Angestellten in Industrie und Handel, Handwerk, Landwirtschaft, Dienstbezüge der Bundesbeamten sowie Realverdienste, Bundesrepublik Deutschland 1950 bis 2006
justification: This dataset (ZA8618) provides German time-series data on gross earnings, salaries, and paid hours for different worker types (blue-collar, white-collar, civil servants) across industries from 1948/1950 through 2006.

returned_title: histat - Datenkompilation online: Ausgewählte Zeitreihen aus Studien zur Entwicklung der Löhne/Gehälter und des Einkommens aus unselbständiger Arbeit in Deutschland, 1844 - 1990
justification: This dataset (ZA8177) offers long-run historical time series on wages, salaries, and dependent employment income in Germany spanning from 1844 through 1990 across various sectors and worker classifications.

returned_title: European Parliament Election Study 2009, Voter Study
justification: This dataset covers EU member states (including Denmark, Germany, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Portugal, United Kingdom, Estonia, Hungary, and Slovenia) during the 2009 European elections. It measures political behavior, attitudes toward European integration, and public trust and evaluations of EU institutions including the European Commission.

This Standard Eurobarometer dataset collected cross-national public opinion data in 2002 across EU member states on political attitudes, support for European integration, and public trust and satisfaction regarding European Union institutions and the European Commission.

As part of the cross-national European Election Study series conducted after the 2004 EP elections, this survey includes thematic modules focusing on political behavior, public knowledge of EU institutions, and public perceptions of the legitimacy and democratic representation of EU bodies.

Fielded in 2002 across European nations including Denmark, Germany, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Portugal, United Kingdom, Slovenia, Hungary, and Estonia, this survey monitors political behavior, trust in international organizations, and evaluations of European governance and institutions.

The German General Social Survey (ALLBUS 2018) was conducted in Germany in 2018 and specifically covers political attitudes and participation, populism, attitudes toward democracy, refugees and immigration, media use, social inequality, right-wing extremism, religion (ISSP Religion IV), social networks (ISSP Social Networks II), trust, well-being, and comprehensive socio-demographics.

Conducted in 1990 by the Berliner Institut für Sozialwissenschaftliche Studien (BISS) and archived at GESIS, this survey dataset specifically examines foreign citizens residing in East Germany/GDR during the post-reunification market transition. It covers key research aspects including migration background, living and work conditions, family circumstances, plans regarding stay and citizenship, German language proficiency, experiences of discrimination, social integration, and intergroup attitudes towards Germans.

This nationwide trend study conducted in early 2023 by the German Centre for Higher Education Research and Science Studies (DZHW) surveys full-time academic staff at German universities. It provides longitudinal data on university research conditions, digital infrastructure, digital scholarly communication, and higher education policy developments post-pandemic.

returned_title: Die Studierendenbefragung in Deutschland (Student Survey in Germany 2021/2022)
justification: A comprehensive longitudinal survey dataset integrating the German Social Survey and Student Survey. It monitors higher education study conditions, digital learning experiences, accessibility, and student challenges at German universities into the 2020s.

A recurring monitoring survey series published by Hochschulforum Digitalisierung (HFD), CHE, and Stifterverband. It collects multi-perspective survey data from university leadership, support staff, instructors, and students regarding the status, trends, strategic challenges, and artificial intelligence integration in digital teaching across German higher education institutions.

This 1967 Emnid survey dataset stored in the GESIS Data Archive specifically covers workforce reading habits, general newspaper and magazine readership, book purchasing, book club membership, preferred article topics, and detailed employee evaluations of Mannesmann's company magazine ('Unser Werktag') in West Germany during the 1960s.

The Politbarometer series (GESIS ZA2391), conducted monthly since 1977 by Forschungsgruppe Wahlen for ZDF, collects German public opinion data on political behavior and attitudes, voting intentions, evaluations of political parties and politicians, economic conditions, and social issues across all German states (including Baden-Württemberg, Bavaria, Berlin, Bremen, Hamburg, Hesse, Lower Saxony, North Rhine-Westphalia, Rhineland-Palatinate, Saarland, and Schleswig-Holstein). The dataset covers the 1990s extensively, featuring East and West Germany comparisons as well as annual cumulative files that integrate short surveys (Kurzbarometer).

returned_title: Berufliche Schulen und Hochschulen in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland 1949-2001 Teil II: Hochschulen (GESIS ZA8202)
justification: This dataset, archived in the GESIS Data Archive and HISTAT (ZA8202) by Peter Lundgreen and Gudrun Schwibbe, provides comprehensive historical time-series data from 1949 to 2001 on higher education in West Germany. It contains detailed student counts categorized by institution type, including technical universities, pedagogical colleges (Pädagogische Hochschulen), theological colleges, art and music academies, and universities of applied sciences (Fachhochschulen).

returned_title: Das Wachstum der deutschen Wirtschaft seit der Mitte des 19. Jahrhunderts (GESIS Study ZA8177)
justification: This foundational historical dataset compiled by Walther G. Hoffmann (hosted in the GESIS archive) provides extensive long-run German economic time series from 1850 through the 1950s. It contains comprehensive quantitative data on German population growth, sectoral workforce, self-employment, female labor participation, enterprise size, and national income production and distribution.

returned_title: HISTAT - Time Series on Historical Statistics of Germany
justification: HISTAT is the primary repository for historical social and economic statistics for 19th and 20th-century Germany (including historical lands and the German Reich). It houses over 400,000 digitized time series covering population censuses, regional workforce distributions, female employment, enterprise structures, and long-term national account metrics from 1850 through 1950.

Published by the German Federal Statistical Office (Destatis), this dataset provides curated historical macroeconomic and demographic time series spanning the mid-19th to mid-20th century, covering long-run population, labor force participation, employment, and aggregate economic output.

returned_title: Cologne High School Panel (CHISP) - Follow-Up 1984/1985: Bildung und Lebenslauf (ZA1441)
justification: This dataset provides 15-year longitudinal follow-up data (conducted in 1984/1985 at age 30) for former 10th-grade high school students originally surveyed in 1969/1970 in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It covers educational and vocational pathways, higher education and career histories, family formation, political participation, attitudes, and domain-specific life satisfaction.

returned_title: Cologne High School Panel (CHISP) - Initial Survey 1969/1970: Strukturanalyse der Schule (ZA0600)
justification: This baseline dataset captures the original 1969/1970 cohort of 10th-grade high school students across North Rhine-Westphalia, recording social origins, family life, school performance, attitudes, and life plans, which served as the foundation for the 15-year follow-up conducted in the mid-1980s.

returned_title: CROCorp: Corpus of Parliamentary Debates in Croatia
justification: CROCorp contains cleaned and pre-processed parliamentary debates from the Croatian Parliament (Sabor) spanning 2003–2020 (five legislative terms). It features over 500,000 speeches alongside metadata on elected representatives and their political party affiliations.

This representative survey (GESIS study ZA8738) was commissioned by the Press and Information Office of the German Federal Government and conducted by forsa between February 19 and February 21, 2024. It surveyed 1,504 German-speaking residents aged 14 and over via computer-assisted telephone interviews (CATI), covering public attitudes toward the war in Ukraine, security concerns, political trust, and related current crises in Germany.

returned_title: GESIS Study ZA0322: Einstellung zu Demonstrationen und zum SDS (Mai 1968)
justification: This representative West German public opinion survey from May 1968 directly addresses student demonstrations, public awareness of protest organizers and goals, support for the Socialist German Student Union (SDS) and Extra-Parliamentary Opposition (APO), opinions on banning or policing SDS activities, alongside demographic variables and party preferences.

returned_title: GESIS Study ZA0524: Politik in der Bundesrepublik (November 1967)
justification: This public opinion survey conducted in West Germany in late 1967 measures citizen attitudes towards government performance, emergency legislation (Notstandsgesetze), state authority, and political demonstrations during the peak era of 1960s student unrest, incorporating respondent demographic data and party preferences.

Provides comprehensive survey data on group-focused enmity (GMF) in Germany, explicitly measuring the devaluation of minorities, antisemitism, xenophobia, sexism, homophobia, anti-Muslim attitudes, authoritarianism, political alienation, and social integration with detailed sociodemographic and migration background variables.

A representative general social survey in 2016 Germany covering political behavior, national identity, social stratification, equality and social exclusion, attitudes toward immigrants and minorities (including a dedicated module on foreigners), and detailed sociodemographics with migration background.

Biennial survey of the adult population in Germany from 2012 that includes modules on economic perceptions, political attitudes and alienation, cultural identity, social stratification, and attitudes toward minorities alongside comprehensive demographic data.

Conducted in 1987 in the German Democratic Republic (GDR) by the Central Institute for Youth Research (ZIJ Leipzig) and archived at GESIS, this dataset includes a dedicated supplementary questionnaire on health status and behavior among East German youth. It covers self-reported health, nutritional habits and knowledge, body weight, smoking and alcohol consumption, as well as school, family, and social influences on adolescent health.

Initiated in 1987 in the GDR with 14-year-old 8th-grade students and continued through the 1990s post-reunification transformation era, this GESIS longitudinal study tracks East German adolescents into adulthood. It collects self-reported data on health, mental well-being, lifestyle behaviors, substance use, and school and family environmental influences.

Infratest dimap conducts regular representative telephone surveys (CATI/dual-frame) in Germany covering the population aged 14 and older. The 2024 DeutschlandTREND surveys capture social and political attitudes, evaluations of federal government policies, personal financial outlook, life satisfaction, and perceptions of European and international politics.

Conducted by Forschungsgruppe Wahlen via computer-assisted telephone interviewing (CATI), this ongoing monthly survey series includes 2024 waves assessing public opinion in Germany regarding federal political institutions, government performance, party preferences, economic/financial situations, and major international/European policy issues.

This dataset uses Computer-Assisted Telephone Interviewing (CATI) to survey citizens across EU Member States, including Germany, in late 2024. It measures political attitudes, perceptions of European and global politics, economic sentiment, and views on national and EU governance.

Conducted by the East German State Committee for Television (Staatliches Komitee für Fernsehen beim Ministerrat der DDR), this dataset contains audience participation and TV viewing behavior survey data from 1985, including evaluation of specific programs, suspense and realism expectations for crime drama (Polizeiruf 110), children's television preferences, and demographics.

This August 1984 GDR survey dataset specifically includes a module examining children's preferences for summer holiday television programming (Ferienprogramm), along with general TV viewing behavior, program ratings, and demographic data.

This 1985 GDR audience survey dataset records TV viewing participation and program ratings, evaluations of realism and expectations for crime drama (Polizeiruf 110), general expectations for TV programming, children's engagement with television, and demographics.

This 1984 audience survey measures GDR television viewing behavior, program evaluation, realism and expectations for major TV entertainment/drama series (Front ohne Gnade), children's holiday program reception, and demographic indicators.

The SOEP is a representative longitudinal panel study in Germany covering the 2000s. It captures individual career trajectories, transitions into self-employment and young entrepreneurship, prior employment history, founding type, and business outcomes. It integrates psychological measures including the Big Five personality traits (collected in 2005 and 2009), locus of control/self-efficacy, work motivation, self-regulation, and comprehensive demographic data.

Established in 2007 by ZEW Mannheim and KfW Bankengruppe, this dataset specifically follows newly founded ventures in Germany annually through their first five years of operation. It records startup trajectories, business performance and survival, founding type (solo vs. team, full-time vs. side-line), founders' prior employment, as well as entrepreneurial motivation, self-efficacy, and demographic characteristics.

A representative dataset of 20,012 employees in Germany surveyed in 2017–2018 by BIBB and BAuA. It covers working conditions, telecommuting, home office frequency, formal agreements, tracking of home office hours, job requirements, performance, and work overload.

returned_title: Personality Traits and Employment: BIBB Follow-Up Survey to the 2018 BIBB/BAuA Employment Survey
justification: A follow-up dataset of 8,010 employees linked to the 2017–2018 BIBB/BAuA survey. It specifically captures work addiction (measured via Dutch Work Addiction Scale subscales for excessive and compulsive working), personality traits, and remote work arrangements.

A representative panel survey of employees in Germany collected in 2017 focusing on time-location flexibility, telework/homeoffice frequency, contractual agreements, ability to record and count remote working hours, and mental health/well-being indicators.

Conducted in 1960 in West Germany, this dataset explores parent and youth perspectives on family authority, adolescent social behavior, leisure activities, friendships, family dynamics, and socioeconomic background.

returned_title: Jugendpfleger - Befragung zur Untersuchung des Jugendpflegeberufes 1965 (ZA0359)
justification: Surveyed youth welfare and clubhouse personnel in West Germany in 1965, capturing institutional perspectives on youth work, clubhouse activities, family influences, and adolescent development.
Assesses youth institutional environments in 1966 West Germany, including adolescent participation in outside youth clubs, sports clubs, leisure behavior, and social development.

returned_title: Integrationsbereitschaft der Jugend im sozialen Wandel / 16-18jährige Comparison (ZA1436 / ZA0156)
justification: Contains survey data comparing West German adolescents from the 1960s (1962 baseline study ZA0156) regarding leisure behavior, youth club involvement, peer and family relationships, social attitudes, and demographic background.

Conducted by the Staatliches Komitee für Fernsehen (Sociological Research Department) in 1986 (GESIS Study ZA7217), this survey measures GDR television viewing behavior, audience participation, evaluations of specific program formats, host/announcer ratings, and respondent demographics.

Preserved at GESIS Data Archive (ZA7344), this 1988 East German dataset tracks weekly audience participation, viewing habits, interest in information, comedy, and social policy broadcasts, alongside detailed demographic variables.

This late-1980s dataset (GESIS Study ZA7398) covers GDR television audience research, examining program viewing frequencies, program evaluations, preferences regarding music and entertainment, announcer assessments, and socio-demographic indicators.

Part of the central GDR television audience survey series at GESIS Data Archive (ZA7170), this 1985 dataset captures mid-1980s viewing behavior, interest in political and social broadcasts, comedy and music preferences, and respondent demographics.

returned_title: GESIS Data Archive Study ZA6948: State Election in Saarland 2017 (Forschungsgruppe Wahlen)
justification: This GESIS dataset contains survey data collected around Saarland state elections, covering voting intentions, party and candidate evaluations, coalition preferences, policy attitudes, and voter demographics.

returned_title: Forschungsgruppe Wahlen Politbarometer Archive (Saarland State Election Polls)
justification: Provides survey data and election analyses for Saarland state elections (including the 2012 election campaign between Annegret Kramp-Karrenbauer and Heiko Maas), capturing voter preferences, candidate popularity ratings, preferred coalition models, economic perceptions, and demographic distributions.

returned_title: Infratest dimap WahlREPORT Saarland 2012 Survey Data & Documentation
justification: Documented survey series and exit poll datasets for the 2012 Saarland state election contest, measuring voting motives, candidate evaluations of Annegret Kramp-Karrenbauer and Heiko Maas, issue priorities, regional socio-economic assessments, and voter demographics.

returned_title: Opinions and Values of Egyptian Students in West Germany
justification: This GESIS survey dataset (ZA3331), conducted between June 1964 and March 1965 by the United States Information Agency (USIA), specifically surveys Egyptian students living in West Germany. It captures their integration and social contact with Germans, satisfaction with higher education in the FRG, political attitudes regarding Egypt and international affairs, views on religion, freedom, foreign aid, development, and post-study return plans.

returned_title: Food for Justice: Power, Politics, and Food Inequalities in a Bioeconomy (Berlin, 2020)
justification: This GESIS dataset provides survey data collected from participants at the 2020 'Wir haben es satt!' demonstration in Berlin, covering sociodemographic details, political participation practices, food justice demands, and household food consumption behaviors.

returned_title: Food for Justice: Power, Politics, and Food Inequalities in a Bioeconomy (Berlin, 2024)
justification: This GESIS dataset contains survey data on respondents at the 2024 'Wir haben es satt!' protest in Berlin (including demonstration walkers and tractor drivers/farmers), focusing on participant demographics, political attitudes, agricultural justice demands, and food production and consumption practices.

This German national income and consumption sample survey from 1988 covers detailed household consumption expenditures (including food, beverages, household appliances, cars, electronics, personal care, finance, and savings) alongside comprehensive demographic data for West Germany in the late 1980s.

This official representative survey conducted in 1983 provides microdata on private household consumption behavior in West Germany, including detailed itemized spending on food, beverages, consumer goods, financial assets, and socio-demographic indicators.

returned_title: Forschungsdatenzentrum der Statistischen Ämter des Bundes und der Länder: Einkommens- und Verbrauchsstichprobe (EVS)
justification: The official landing page for the German Income and Consumption Survey (EVS) series, which includes datasets collected every five years (including 1983 and 1988) on private household expenditures, durables, debt/savings, and living conditions in Germany.

returned_title: Social Structure and Way of Life in Cities and Villages 1987 (ZA6336)
justification: This GDR survey conducted in 1987 covers living conditions, employment, housing, leisure and cultural activities, transport, community life, and neighborhood satisfaction across various urban and rural settlements in the German Democratic Republic.

returned_title: Sociological Investigation of Residential Areas of the City of Rostock 1982 (ZA6358)
justification: This GDR survey conducted in 1982 focuses on urban residential conditions, housing, neighborhood ties, satisfaction with local amenities, commuting and transport to work, leisure habits, and local attachment/belonging.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme: Social Relations and Support Systems - ISSP 2001
justification: This dataset from the International Social Survey Programme (ISSP 2001, ZA3680) directly covers topics in social behavior and attitudes, social stratification and groupings, and family life and marriage. It was fielded during the 2000s across 28 included countries and territories (Australia, Austria, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Great Britain, Hungary, Israel, Italy, Japan, Latvia, New Zealand, Northern Ireland, Norway, Philippines, Poland, Russian Federation, Slovenia, Spain, South Africa, Switzerland, and the USA). As part of a repeated annual cross-national survey program, it provides standardized comparative data specifically designed for over-time and cross-country comparisons on social networks, personal support systems, and social relations.

returned_title: ALLBUS/GGSS 1994 (Allgemeine Bevölkerungsumfrage der Sozialwissenschaften/German General Social Survey 1994)
justification: This representative survey conducted in 1994 covers political attitudes, participation, voting behavior, trust in institutions, media usage, and social security in Germany, with explicit sampling and measures for East-West differences following reunification.

returned_title: ALLBUS/GGSS 1998 (Allgemeine Bevölkerungsumfrage der Sozialwissenschaften/German General Social Survey 1998)
justification: Featuring a primary topical module on political participation and attitudes toward the political system, this 1998 survey measures democratic values, political efficacy, social inequality, and post-reunification East-West differences across Germany.
Conducted in 1990, this survey captures voting behavior, party preferences, and political attitudes in East Germany during the critical transition period immediately following reunification.
Provides longitudinal survey data collected throughout the 1990s on party preferences, government evaluation, political trust, and voter attitudes across both West and East Germany.

returned_title: World Values Survey: Round Six - Country-Pooled Datafile (2010-2014)
justification: Cross-national survey conducted between 2010 and 2014 covering religiosity, moral values (abortion, sexuality), attitudes toward gender equality, church-state relations, trust, science, subjective wellbeing, and socio-demographics across Algeria, Ghana, Jordan, Malaysia, Nigeria, Singapore, and other nations.

returned_title: World Values Survey: Round Seven - Country-Pooled Datafile (2017-2022)
justification: Cross-national comparative survey executed in the late 2010s measuring religiosity, trust, gender equality, sexuality, abortion, church-state relations, and political-demographic traits across requested countries including Indonesia, Jordan, Kenya, Malaysia, Mongolia, Nepal, Nigeria, Singapore, and Viet Nam.

returned_title: Pew Research Center's World's Muslims Data Set, 2012
justification: Cross-national dataset of over 30,000 interviews conducted in 2011–2012 gauging religious beliefs and practices, moral attitudes (abortion, sexuality), views on gender equality, church-state relations (sharia law), trust, and political-demographic characteristics in countries including Algeria, Ghana, Indonesia, Jordan, Kenya, Malaysia, and Nigeria.

Cross-national public opinion survey across 36 African countries in the mid-2010s (including Algeria, Ghana, Kenya, Malawi, and Nigeria), capturing data on religious identification, social distance, trust, gender equality, wellbeing, and political-demographic characteristics.

Cross-national survey conducted in 2012–2014 covering religious values, church-state relations, trust, gender equality, personal wellbeing, and political-demographic characteristics in Arab nations including Algeria and Jordan.

returned_title: European Public Opinion and Foreign Policy: A Continuity Dataset (1952–1970)
justification: This dataset pools United States Information Agency (USIA) survey data from 1952 to 1970 across France, Great Britain, West Germany, and Italy. It tracks individual-level public attitudes on Cold War security, nuclear disarmament, NATO, West Berlin, perceptions of the US, USSR, and China, and European Common Market integration.

Hosted by the Roper Center for Public Opinion Research, this archive contains 1950s and 1960s USIA survey reports and datasets measuring public opinion in France, Great Britain, West Germany, and Italy on international conflict, NATO, Cold War crises, nuclear capabilities, and European integration.

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 383: Firearms in the European Union
justification: Conducted in 2013 across 28 European Union Member States, this Eurobarometer survey provides microdata on public attitudes toward gun ownership, regulations, perception of firearm-related crime, and international trafficking concerns.

Maintained by the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime, this dataset contains administrative and survey data on illicit firearms seizures, trafficking flows, types of arms seized, legal justifications, and associated offences across EU member states and globally during the 2010s.

returned_title: Small Arms Survey Global Firearms Holdings Database
justification: Provides national-level baseline estimates (compiled in 2017) of firearm ownership disaggregated by civilian, law enforcement, and military holdings across all EU member states and international jurisdictions.

Conducted by the Institute for Public Opinion Research (IVVM) in 2000 and available via the CESSDA Data Catalogue and Czech Social Science Data Archive (CSDA), this dataset captures monthly public opinion survey data across the Czech Republic. It covers political party preferences, voting behavior, trust in political leaders and institutions, satisfaction with democracy, EU attitudes, economic conditions, household living standards, region, community size, and religiosity.

returned_title: CVVM / IVVM - Naše společnost (Our Society) 2000 Monthly Public Opinion Surveys
justification: The continuous public opinion research project 'Naše společnost' (Our Society) conducted by IVVM/CVVM in 2000 and archived at the Czech Social Science Data Archive (CSDA) contains monthly survey data on Czech adults' political behavior, party choices, trust in government and democratic institutions, EU accession attitudes, personal and national economic evaluations, household living standards, religion, region, and settlement size.

returned_title: Die Reichstagswahlen und Reichspräsidentschaftswahlen in Kiel 1925-1932 (GESIS ZA8080)
justification: This GESIS dataset specifically contains historical election results across 156 voting districts (Stimmbezirke) in Kiel for the Weimar Republic Reichstag elections (1928, 1930, July 1932, November 1932) and the Reich presidential elections in 1925 and 1932.

This collection provides aggregated electoral returns and demographic data for Germany during the Weimar Republic period, including Reichstag elections from 1920 to 1933 as well as the 1925 and 1932 Reich presidential elections.

returned_title: Responsiveness and Public Opinion in Germany (ResPOG)
justification: This GESIS dataset aggregates survey data from 1980 to 2016 on West German and reunited German public opinion regarding international politics, security policy, NATO, East-West power dynamics, political systems, and economic policy, linked with socio-demographic respondent variables.

Conducted in West Germany throughout 1983 by Forschungsgruppe Wahlen for the ZDF and archived at GESIS, this dataset tracks public opinion on Cold War security policy, NATO alignment versus neutrality, US versus Soviet political and military power, reactions to Soviet leadership under Yuri Andropov, party sympathy, and detailed respondent demographics.

returned_title: Internationale Beziehungen (USIA / GESIS Data Archive ZA2072)
justification: Archived in the GESIS Data Archive, this survey series measures public attitudes in West Germany regarding international relations, conflict, security policy, alliance alignment, and foreign political leadership.

returned_title: Kriminalität in der modernen Stadt – Panel (ZA8867)
justification: The 'Crime in the Modern City' (CrimoC) prospective panel study started in Duisburg in 2002, tracking a cohort of 7th-grade students from early adolescence into adulthood across 13 waves. It provides extensive longitudinal data on self-reported offending, crime victimization, school experiences, criminal attitudes, lifestyle, leisure time use, family background, and subsequent vocational education and employment transitions.

returned_title: GLES 2013 Pre- and Post-election Cross Section (Cumulation) (ZA5702)
justification: This dataset from the German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) provides cumulative cross-sectional survey data collected before and after the 2013 German federal election. It covers political attitudes, vote intentions and behavior, party evaluations, media exposure, economic perceptions, trust in political institutions, issue positions, and detailed socio-demographic indicators.

returned_title: GLES 2013 Rolling Cross-Section Campaign Survey with Post-election Panel Wave (ZA5703)
justification: Part of the 2013 German Longitudinal Election Study, this dataset tracks daily dynamic changes during the election campaign and includes a post-election panel wave. It measures political attitudes, voting decision processes, party evaluations, media usage, social discussions, economic outlook, issue salience, and detailed demographics.

Conducted immediately after the 2013 German federal election as part of GLES, this survey captures post-election vote choices, political attitudes, party evaluations, political trust, issue preferences, media consumption patterns, and comprehensive demographic characteristics.

returned_title: University Students' Values, Vocations, and Political Orientations: Uruguay, 1966
justification: This 1966 dataset collected by Seymour Martin Lipset surveys university students in Uruguay on higher education issues, student and faculty involvement in politics, perspectives on national and international social and economic issues, and demographic characteristics such as age, sex, religion, and family educational background.

returned_title: European Values Study Longitudinal Data File, 1981-2008
justification: This longitudinal cross-national dataset integrates European Values Study survey waves from 1981, 1990, 1999, and 2008, including coverage for Great Britain and Northern Ireland during the 1990s. It covers comparative attitudes on religion, family life, politics, morality, work, social trust, national identity, and well-being alongside demographic and regional indicators.

Fielded in 1990 across 27 European countries/regions including Great Britain and Northern Ireland, this survey dataset provides cross-national comparative data on public attitudes toward work, family, religion, political systems, democracy, morality, social trust, and life satisfaction with demographic breakdowns.

Fielded at the end of the 1990s across 33 European countries/regions including Great Britain and Northern Ireland, this comparative survey captures European values and attitudes regarding religion, morality, politics, democracy, work, primary relations, family, and national identity.

Fielded in 1990 in Great Britain, this dataset measures social and political attitudes, covering topics such as economic systems, government and politics, family life, social stratification, moral values, and religion accompanied by detailed demographic and regional variables.

The ALLBUS cumulative dataset tracks West German adults across the 1980s and beyond, capturing core indicators on moral values, religion, political attitudes, party identification, family background, children, education, employment, income, and historical reflections.

This 1988 wave of the ALLBUS survey sampled adults in West Germany and covers personal and political values, party identification, family origin, youth socialization, education, work history, income, and retrospective attitudes towards earlier decades.

This dataset aggregates the 1980, 1982, 1984, and 1986 ALLBUS survey waves in West Germany, offering comprehensive survey data on social conditions, moral/religious orientations, political party affiliation, family background, education, and labor force participation during the 1980s.

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 221: Dual Circulation Period in Malta
justification: Provides survey microdata collected in Malta in January 2008 immediately following euro adoption [5.3.1]. It captures consumer payment behavior, everyday cash handling, and public attitudes during the dual circulation period.

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 237: Introduction of the Euro in the New Member States
justification: Covers public attitudes, mental conversion habits, perceived price increases, and consumer adaptation to euro adoption in Malta and other new EU member states following their changeovers.

returned_title: Eurostat Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP)
justification: Delivers official statistical time series tracking consumer price developments, category-level price indices, and inflation in Malta before, during, and after its 2008 euro adoption.

This GESIS dataset contains representative survey data collected in March 1986 by the GDR's Staatliches Komitee für Fernsehen. It measures TV viewing participation, evaluations of specific TV films and series, ratings of moderators, TV favorites, entertainment realism, and demographic background variables in East Germany.

Conducted in 1982 by the GDR State Committee for Television's Sociological Research Department, this survey dataset captures East German TV viewing habits, ratings of specific broadcasts, evaluations of entertainment value, authenticity, realism, moderators, and demographic indicators.

This dataset documents weekly audience research in East Germany from April 1987, covering TV viewing habits, evaluation of moderators, ratings of specific television films and series, overall program impressions, and household demographic variables.

returned_title: Data Base on Members of German National Parliaments 1848-1933
justification: Hosted by GESIS Data Archive for the Social Sciences (ZA8008), this dataset provides structured collective biographies and parliamentary group data for national parliamentarians in Germany up to 1933, directly covering education, occupations, political functions, careers, and power structures of Weimar Republic parliamentary elites.

returned_title: BIOWEIL - Kollektive Biographie der Landtagsabgeordneten der Weimarer Republik 1918-1933
justification: Created by Wilhelm Heinz Schröder, Wilhelm Weege, and Martina Zech, this dataset reconstructs collective biographical profiles of around 6,000 state parliament delegates (Landtagsabgeordnete) in the Weimar Republic, detailing education, occupations, organizational memberships, state parliament service, political functions, and persecution.

Distributed via ICPSR, this dataset compiles election returns, demographic metrics, and occupational census data across Wahlkreise and regional units for Weimar Republic national and presidential elections between 1919 and 1933, serving as a key context for Weimar parliamentary power structures.

returned_title: Hörbeteiligung und Hörstandort April 1987 Zusatz: Berliner Rundfunk am Sonntag
justification: Conducted by the Staatliches Komitee für Rundfunk in April 1987, this GESIS dataset includes survey data on radio listening behavior in East Berlin and the GDR. It covers station choice (focusing on Berliner Rundfunk and its regional broadcasts such as the evening magazine 'Berliner Luft'), timing, frequency, and detailed demographic and employment characteristics of listeners.

returned_title: Hörbeteiligung und Gesellungsform November 1984 Zusatz: Radiohören am Werktagabend
justification: Gathered in late 1984 by the DDR's Staatliches Komitee für Rundfunk, this study evaluates weekday evening radio listening patterns, station preferences (including regional programming on Berliner Rundfunk), timing, and respondent demographic and employment profiles.

returned_title: Hörbeteiligung und Paralleltätigkeit Juni 1981 Zusatz: Phonotechnische Ausstattung
justification: This 1981 GESIS dataset from the GDR's Department of Sociological Research captures day-to-day radio consumption, station selection (including regional broadcasts in East Berlin), timing and frequency of listening, and comprehensive socio-demographic and occupational data.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 47.2: Women and Cancer, the European Parliament, and Expectations of the European Union, April-June 1997
justification: This survey dataset covers the 15 EU member states in 1997 (including Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, United Kingdom [Great Britain and Northern Ireland], Austria, Sweden, and Finland). It includes modules on public attitudes towards EU membership, trust in European institutions, referendum choices, citizens' rights, and a major focus module on women and cancer—specifically measuring knowledge, participation, and information sources regarding breast cancer screening, accompanied by standard socio-demographic variables.

returned_title: GESIS ZA0418: Schuhmacher (1962) - Befragung über die soziale Lage im Schuhmacherhandwerk
justification: Conducted in 1962 by the Institut für Mittelstandsforschung in Cologne (North Rhine-Westphalia), this study specifically investigates shoemakers and small craft businesses in advanced industrial society. The questionnaire covers self-employment vs. employment, social prestige, business structure, family labor, mechanization, competition, financing, politics, and demographic background.

returned_title: Gross Income of Workers and Employees in Industry and Commerce, Handicraft, Agriculture, Emoluments of Federal Officials and Actual Earnings, Federal Republic of Germany 1950 - 2006 (ZA8618)
justification: This historical GESIS dataset provides official statistical data on wages, gross earnings, and employment structure in handicrafts (Handwerk) and industry in West Germany (including North Rhine-Westphalia) during the 1960s.

The Gutenberg Health Study is a prospective population-based cohort study initiated in 2007 by the University Medical Center Mainz in Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany. Examining over 15,000 adults aged 35–74 during the 2000s and 2010s, it collects detailed health data on medical conditions (cardiovascular, cancer, eye diseases, metabolic, mental health), medication and treatments, adult vaccination coverage, preventive checkups, screening participation, smoking, alcohol, diet, physical activity, blood pressure metrics, and demographic characteristics.

returned_title: German Health Update (GEDA 2019/2020-EHIS) - Robert Koch Institute
justification: GEDA is a repeated population-based health survey conducted by the Robert Koch Institute (RKI) covering all German federal states, including Rhineland-Palatinate. It collects standardized data on adult health outcomes, disease prevalence, medication usage, adult vaccination coverage, preventive checkups and cancer screenings, lifestyle risk factors (smoking, alcohol, diet, physical activity), blood pressure awareness, health risk perceptions, and detailed sociodemographic characteristics.

returned_title: Intervallstudie: Entwicklungsfaktoren und Entwicklungsformen von Jugendlichen in der DDR (1968-1980) IS I - 1970 (3. Welle)
justification: This GESIS dataset from the Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung (ZIJ) in Leipzig is part of a multi-wave longitudinal panel study following East German youth during the 1970s. It contains survey data covering youth personality and social development, political attitudes, FDJ participation, media consumption, school performance, career goals, health behaviors, family background, and social conditions.

returned_title: Intervallstudie: Entwicklungsfaktoren und Entwicklungsformen von Jugendlichen in der DDR (1968-1980) IS I - 1975 (8. Welle)
justification: This wave of the ZIJ longitudinal youth study tracks East German youth through the mid-1970s, measuring career aspirations, school-to-work transition, political/ideological attitudes, FDJ involvement, media preferences, health and lifestyle habits, and family relationships.

returned_title: Intervallstudie: Entwicklungsfaktoren und Entwicklungsformen von Jugendlichen in der DDR (1968-1980) IS I - 1978 (11. Welle)
justification: This late-1970s wave of the ZIJ longitudinal study examines personality development, social environment, political orientations, media use, FDJ participation, health behavior, work and family life among young people in the German Democratic Republic.

returned_title: United Nations Surveys of Crime Trends and Operations of Criminal Justice Systems Series, Waves 1-10, 1970-2006
justification: Provides long-run comparative cross-national time-series data on recorded violent crime (including intentional homicide and assault), criminal prosecution, and imprisonment rates across Germany, the UK, Sweden, and the USA covering the 1970s through 2000s.

Offers annual comparative time-series macro-data for 36 OECD countries—including Germany, Britain, Sweden, and the United States—spanning 1960 to the 2000s on unemployment, income inequality, welfare state expenditures, labor market indicators, and demographic/family change.

Contains standardized multi-wave cross-national survey data spanning 1989 through the 2000s on crime victimization (including assault and violent crime), security perceptions, feelings of insecurity, and police reporting across Germany, England, Sweden, and the United States.

Delivers long-term country-level longitudinal time-series data (1815 to present) for over 200 countries, covering domestic conflict events, political stability, socio-economic variables, and government expenditures for Germany, Britain, Sweden, and the US across the 1950s–2000s.

returned_title: histat - Datenkompilation online: Entwicklung der Arbeitslosigkeit in Deutschland 1887 – 2000
justification: This GESIS histat dataset compiles historical time-series data on German unemployment rates, trade union unemployment statistics, employment participation, and labor market indicators starting in 1887 through the Kaiserreich (1890–1918) and Weimar Republic.

Created by Mark Spoerer, this dataset contains local customary daily wage data ('ortsüblicher Tagelohn') across 210 German municipalities between 1885 and 1914, used by Imperial health insurance funds and local labor authorities to determine baseline benefits and assess local labor market conditions.

returned_title: histat - Datenkompilation online: Ausgewählte Zeitreihen aus Studien zur Lohn- und Gehaltsentwicklung und der Einkommensentwicklung in Deutschland von 1850 bis 1985
justification: Integrates empirical time series from key historical studies on German labor markets, including Toni Pierenkemper's dataset on labor supply, white-collar employees, and labor market segmentation during the German Empire (1880–1913).

returned_title: histat - Datenkompilation online: Soziale Sicherung in Deutschland, 1885 – 2010
justification: Provides quantitative time series on the development of social security, public relief, and early labor policy instruments in Germany from 1885 onwards, covering public welfare expenditures and labor market relief measures during the Kaiserreich and Weimar eras.

returned_title: ALICE Dataset - Analyzing Learning for Individualized Competence Development in Mathematics and Science Education
justification: Created as part of the ALICE project (2021–2024) led by the IPN Kiel in Schleswig-Holstein, this dataset covers secondary school students in STEM subjects including physics. It captures individual digital learning trajectories, student difficulties, and interaction data used to feed teacher dashboards (such as the LA Cockpit) for near real-time feedback and targeted instructional interventions to turn unproductive learning into productive learning.

returned_title: ALICE Project Page - Leibniz Institute for Science and Mathematics Education (IPN Kiel)
justification: Landing page for the ALICE research project based in Kiel, Schleswig-Holstein, detailing the collection and analysis of digital classroom process and product data across secondary school STEM subjects (including physics) to track learning progressions, diagnose difficulties, and enable teacher interventions in real-time.

Conducted in 1990 by the Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung (ZIJ) Leipzig in East Germany (former GDR), this survey dataset covers young students' romantic relationships, sexual attitudes and behavior, age at first intercourse, contraceptive practices, AIDS risk perceptions, homosexuality, family background, and personal wellbeing.

Conducted in 1990 by the Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung (ZIJ) Leipzig, this study surveys young East German apprentices regarding romantic relationships, sexual behavior, first sexual intercourse, contraception, AIDS risk awareness, sexual violence attitudes, parent-child communication, and wellbeing.

Conducted in 1990 in the former GDR context, this dataset investigates homosexuality, romantic partner relationships, sexual behavior, AIDS risk perception, family and social support networks, and psychological wellbeing among young people.

Conducted in East Germany between 1991 and 1993, this dataset examines young homosexual women's partner relationships, sexual health, coming-out experiences, family background, discrimination, and overall wellbeing following the end of the GDR.

Conducted in early 2011 across 27 European countries (Belgium, Germany, Spain, Greece, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Austria, Portugal, Finland, Slovenia, Cyprus, Malta, Slovakia, Bulgaria, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Latvia, Hungary, Poland, Romania, Sweden, United Kingdom, and Lithuania), this survey dataset collects microdata on internet users' language preferences online. It covers preferred interface languages, languages used for reading and writing online, frequency of using non-native languages, and multilingual online behavior across various activities.
